userDirection: Terrain varies by region: browns, darker ground; roads may be wide or narrow dirt routes as well as some stone main routes.
paletteEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit, regional terrain palette.
Input 1 is the edit target: the continuous ground-only terrain master for two adjoining game map sections. Input 2 is the fixed camp-edge style reference. Input 3 is the overall geographic guide, not a scale or style replacement.

Make one targeted improvement to INPUT 1: introduce natural regional ground colour variation in the NEW northern terrain. Preserve the image composition, overhead camera, paving fragment positions, leaf/grit scale, all dirt-path routes and their exact edge entry/exit positions.
The leftmost 10% and bottommost 12% must stay EXACTLY the existing warm ochre camp/junction palette and textures, because these connect to already published terrain. Work a very gradual, irregular transition starting beyond the leftmost 25% and above the bottommost 25%. Through the upper central and upper right ground, use richer chestnut brown, umber, some softly darker moist-looking earth and muted olive moss. Reduce the bright orange saturation of the SOIL in that new region. Let local patches vary organically; no straight boundary, no rectangular zones, no overall brown filter. The overall area should visibly feel browner, quieter and slightly darker as one walks north, while the bottom and left still slot perfectly into the original camp.

The dirt route stays legible: compacted light warm brown ground, naturally widening in a few worn places and narrowing on the small eastern footpath. Keep these roads as DIRT with grit; only keep the few existing flat paving fragments at the top. Do not turn the paths into stone roads. Keep fallen leaves small, flat, varied rust/orange/brown and scattered; do not make flowers. Preserve the shapes of the current texture, adding natural ground variation rather than shadow overlays.

Same wide 3072:1660 composition, opaque, highest available resolution. No new objects, trees, bushes, tall grass, boulders, buildings, water, rails, signs, labels, borders, vignette, map grid, blur, or cast shadows. Only terrain colour/material variation in the new northward ground. Preserve the known contact strips.
